deadlines.title: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS EOS (Intune)
deadlines.action: Identify 22.04 devices in Intune and start upgrade comms. New enrollments blocked after EOS.
deadlines.applies_to: Intune-managed Linux fleets

deadlines.title: Teams Rooms IntelliFrame People Labels (Windows) GA
deadlines.action: Plan face-enrollment policy and confirm camera compatibility for Rooms devices ahead of GA.
deadlines.applies_to: Orgs running Teams Rooms Pro on Windows with compatible intelligent cameras

deadlines.title: Teams Rooms on Android: Front-of-Room View Control GA
deadlines.action: If you run Town Halls from Rooms on Android, plan testing ahead of GA.
deadlines.applies_to: Orgs running Town Halls via Teams Rooms Pro on Android

deadlines.title: Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Archive OneDrive/SharePoint Files Under Retention
deadlines.action: Evaluate retention-covered file volumes ahead of the August preview to identify storage cost savings, and confirm archiving policies align with e-discovery/regulatory retention obligations before September GA.
deadlines.applies_to: Orgs managing storage costs alongside e-discovery or regulatory retention requirements

deadlines.title: Purview DLP: Granular Classification Error Controls (Exchange Online)
deadlines.action: Review existing DLP policies for Exchange Online and decide whether to split blanket failure-handling rules into per-error-type controls (timeout, throttling, scan errors) once this GAs.
deadlines.applies_to: Orgs running Purview DLP policies against Exchange Online

deadlines.title: Purview DLP: User-Based Aggregation of Alerts
deadlines.action: Expect DLP alert volumes/grouping to change as related events consolidate per user. Review alert-triage runbooks and any automation keyed to individual alert IDs before this lands.
deadlines.applies_to: Orgs with active Purview DLP alerting and SOC triage workflows

deadlines.title: OneDrive: Exclude Specific Folders from Syncing
deadlines.action: Decide whether to set org-wide folder exclusion rules (e.g. dev tooling folders) once available, to keep local-only folders out of OneDrive by policy rather than per-user opt-out.
deadlines.applies_to: Orgs managing OneDrive sync policy on Windows/Mac endpoints

deadlines.title: Copilot in PowerPoint: GCC / Sovereign Cloud GA
deadlines.action: Add to your GCC/GCC-H Copilot rollout timeline and validate brand kit configuration ahead of release.
deadlines.applies_to: GCC and sovereign cloud Copilot tenants

deadlines.title: SharePoint Auto-Labeling for Data at Rest (Preview)
deadlines.action: Audit SharePoint library default sensitivity label configurations before the September preview activates, to avoid unintended DLP blocks or access restrictions when existing unlabeled files get auto-labeled ahead of October GA.
deadlines.applies_to: Orgs with SharePoint libraries carrying default sensitivity labels

deadlines.title: Purview eDiscovery (Premium): Hold Reports
deadlines.action: Plan to use the new out-of-the-box hold reports for legal hold audits instead of custom exports once available - update internal e-discovery documentation to reference the built-in report.
deadlines.applies_to: Legal/compliance teams running eDiscovery Premium cases

deadlines.title: Purview Label Inheritance from Email Attachments (Outlook, incl. iOS/Android)
deadlines.action: Review sensitivity label policies for attachments - labels will start inheriting automatically across desktop and mobile Outlook, which may change labeling behavior your DLP rules currently assume.
deadlines.applies_to: Orgs using Purview sensitivity labels on email attachments

deadlines.title: Purview Information Protection: Auto-Labeling Per-Policy Coverage
deadlines.action: Review auto-labeling policy scope once per-policy coverage reporting ships - useful for confirming which policies are actually catching content before relying on them for compliance attestation.
deadlines.applies_to: Orgs relying on Purview auto-labeling for compliance coverage

deadlines.title: Purview DLP: Data Security for Non-Microsoft Cloud Apps
deadlines.action: Scope which third-party SaaS apps you'd want DLP coverage extended to once this ships, and plan a pilot policy for your highest-risk non-Microsoft app.
deadlines.applies_to: Orgs with sensitive data flowing through non-Microsoft SaaS apps

deadlines.title: Microsoft Edge: Local IP Address Detection Change for Proxy Auto-Config
deadlines.action: If your org relies on PAC scripts / proxy auto-config that assume current local IP detection behavior, test against Edge Insider builds before this rolls out broadly.
deadlines.applies_to: Orgs managing Edge proxy configuration via PAC scripts

deadlines.title: Copilot Studio: Dataverse Integration
deadlines.action: If you're building Copilot Studio agents, evaluate using Dataverse as a native knowledge source instead of custom connectors once this ships.
deadlines.applies_to: Teams building custom agents in Copilot Studio

deadlines.title: EWS Disablement in Exchange Online
deadlines.action: Audit all apps/service accounts still authenticating via EWS. Configure EWSAllowedAppIDs for stragglers and set internal migration milestones now - don't wait for enforcement to discover dependencies.
deadlines.applies_to: Orgs with apps or service accounts still authenticating to Exchange Online via EWS

deadlines.title: Purview Endpoint DLP: Policy Sync & Device Health AI-Powered Investigation
deadlines.action: No action required to adopt, but expect DLP policy sync failures to start surfacing root-cause explanations and recommended fixes automatically - worth a heads-up to whoever triages sync alerts today.
deadlines.applies_to: Orgs running Purview Endpoint DLP across managed devices

deadlines.title: Purview Endpoint DLP: Protect Sensitive Data over FTP/SFTP
deadlines.action: If FTP/SFTP is a known exfiltration gap in your current DLP coverage, plan a policy pilot for this once it ships - it's new protocol coverage, not a change to existing policies.
deadlines.applies_to: Orgs with FTP/SFTP transfer paths from managed endpoints

deadlines.title: Microsoft Teams: Malicious URL Protection for Chat/Channels (Gov Clouds)
deadlines.action: Confirm this closes a known protection gap for your Gov cloud tenant relative to commercial Teams, and update any compliance documentation that notes the discrepancy.
deadlines.applies_to: GCC, GCC High, and DoD Teams tenants

deadlines.title: Purview DLP: Restrict Copilot Processing of External Emails GA
deadlines.action: Begin policy design for restricting Copilot's processing of external emails ahead of the January 2027 GA, particularly if your organization handles regulated data via email.
deadlines.applies_to: Orgs with HIPAA/GDPR obligations around email data handled by Copilot

watching.title: OWA Light Retirement in Exchange Server
watching.action: Audit for users, browser policies, or helpdesk documentation pointing to the light client (`?layout=light`) and redirect them to standard Outlook on the web. Update internal training/help desk scripts now — no fallback exists once Microsoft disables it.
watching.applies_to: Exchange Server (on-premises) customers with users still on OWA Light
watching.note: Microsoft has confirmed the retirement direction but has not published a specific date yet.
